ucs.title: [LLM] Volt Typhoon NTDS.dit theft via ntdsutil IFM + VSS shadow on Domain Controllers
ucs.description: Hunts the exact credential-access chain CISA AA24-038A attributes to Volt Typhoon (Vanguard Panda / BRONZE SILHOUETTE): ntdsutil.exe spawned with 'ac i ntds' + 'ifm' + 'create full', or vssadmin create shadow + esentutl/copy of ntds.dit. Volt Typhoon is hands-on-keyboard and lives off the land - they prefer ntdsutil/vssadmin over mimikatz so they leave only signed Microsoft binaries on disk.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where ( (Processes.process_name=ntdsutil.exe AND (Processes.process="*ifm*" OR Processes.process="*create full*" OR Processes.process="*ac i ntds*" OR Processes.process="*activate instance ntds*")) OR (Processes.process_name=vssadmin.exe AND Processes.process="*create shadow*") OR (Processes.process_name=esentutl.exe AND (Processes.process="*/y*" OR Processes.process="*/vss*" OR Processes.process="*ntds.dit*")) OR (Processes.process_name IN (cmd.exe,powershell.exe,pwsh.exe,wmic.exe,robocopy.exe,xcopy.exe) AND Processes.process="*ntds.dit*") ) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_id _time | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where NOT match(user, "\\$$") | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"            // exclude machine accounts
| where (FileName =~ "ntdsutil.exe"
          and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("ifm", "create full", "ac i ntds", "activate instance ntds"))
      or (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe"
          and ProcessCommandLine has "create shadow")
      or (FileName =~ "esentutl.exe"
          and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("/y", "/vss", "ntds.dit"))
      or (FileName in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wmic.exe","robocopy.exe","xcopy.exe")
          and ProcessCommandLine has "ntds.dit")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend Img = tolower(NewProcessName), Cmd = tolower(CommandLine)
| where (Img endswith "\\ntdsutil.exe"
          and (Cmd has "ifm" or Cmd has "create full" or Cmd has "ac i ntds" or Cmd has "activate instance ntds"))
      or (Img endswith "\\vssadmin.exe" and Cmd has "create shadow")
      or (Img endswith "\\esentutl.exe" and (Cmd has "/y" or Cmd has "/vss" or Cmd has "ntds.dit"))
      or (Img endswith_any ("\\cmd.exe","\\powershell.exe","\\pwsh.exe","\\wmic.exe","\\robocopy.exe","\\xcopy.exe")
          and Cmd has "ntds.dit")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName, SubjectUserName
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Volt Typhoon - NTDS.dit Extraction via ntdsutil IFM / VSS Shadow
id: 5d7a2c8b-3f4e-4a91-b6c7-9a2d1e8f3b5c
status: experimental
description: Detects the signature Volt Typhoon (Vanguard Panda) credential-access chain - ntdsutil 'ac i ntds' + 'ifm' + 'create full', vssadmin shadow creation, or esentutl/copy of ntds.dit (CISA AA24-038A).
references:
    - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa24-038a
    - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1017/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/31
tags:
    - attack.credential_access
    - attack.t1003.003
    - attack.t1003
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection_ntdsutil:
        Image|endswith: '\ntdsutil.exe'
        CommandLine|contains:
            - 'ifm'
            - 'create full'
            - 'ac i ntds'
            - 'activate instance ntds'
    selection_vssadmin:
        Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
        CommandLine|contains: 'create shadow'
    selection_esentutl:
        Image|endswith: '\esentutl.exe'
        CommandLine|contains:
            - '/y'
            - '/vss'
            - 'ntds.dit'
    selection_copy:
        Image|endswith:
            - '\cmd.exe'
            - '\powershell.exe'
            - '\pwsh.exe'
            - '\wmic.exe'
            - '\robocopy.exe'
            - '\xcopy.exe'
        CommandLine|contains: 'ntds.dit'
    condition: 1 of selection_*
falsepositives:
    - Authorized DC backup or IFM media creation for promoting a new replica
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.security OR windows.sysmon) (@EventID:4688 OR @EventID:1) ((@Image:(*\ntdsutil.exe OR *\NTDSUtil.exe OR *\NTDSUTIL.EXE) @CommandLine:(*ifm* OR *IFM* OR *"create full"* OR *"Create Full"* OR *"ac i ntds"* OR *"activate instance ntds"*)) OR (@Image:(*\vssadmin.exe OR *\VSSAdmin.exe OR *\VSSADMIN.EXE) @CommandLine:(*"create shadow"* OR *"Create Shadow"*)) OR (@Image:(*\esentutl.exe OR *\EseUtil.exe OR *\ESENTUTL.EXE) @CommandLine:(*/y* OR */vss* OR *ntds.dit* OR *NTDS.dit* OR *NTDS.DIT*)) OR (@CommandLine:(*ntds.dit* OR *NTDS.dit* OR *NTDS.DIT*) -@Image:(*\lsass.exe OR *\LSASS.EXE)))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (ImageFileName=/\\ntdsutil\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/(ifm|create\s+full|ac\s+i\s+ntds|activate\s+instance\s+ntds)/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\vssadmin\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/create\s+shadow/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\esentutl\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/(\/y|\/vss|ntds\.dit)/i)
  OR (regex("ntds\.dit", field=CommandLine, strict=false) AND NOT ImageFileName=/\\lsass\.exe$/i)
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=[count(), min(_time, as=FirstSeen), max(_time, as=LastSeen)])
| sort(LastSeen, order=desc)

ucs.title: [LLM] Volt Typhoon internal pivot via netsh portproxy relay (KV-Botnet handoff)
ucs.description: Catches the netsh.exe 'interface portproxy add v4to*' relay configuration that Volt Typhoon (VOLTZITE / Vanguard Panda) uses to hop laterally through compromised internal hosts and exfiltrate via SOHO-router edge nodes of the KV Botnet. This is one of the most diagnostic single-event signals for the actor.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name=netsh.exe AND Processes.process="*interface*" AND Processes.process="*portproxy*" AND (Processes.process="*add v4tov4*" OR Processes.process="*add v4tov6*" OR Processes.process="*add v6tov4*" OR Processes.process="*add v6tov6*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_id _time | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where NOT match(user, "\\$$") | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"            // exclude SYSTEM / machine accounts
| where FileName =~ "netsh.exe"
| where ProcessCommandLine has "interface"
   and ProcessCommandLine has "portproxy"
   and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("add v4tov4", "add v4tov6", "add v6tov4", "add v6tov6")
| extend ListenPort = extract(@"(?i)listenport=([0-9]+)", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| extend ConnectAddr = extract(@"(?i)connectaddress=([^\s]+)", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| extend ConnectPort = extract(@"(?i)connectport=([0-9]+)", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| join kind=leftouter (
    DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "svchost.exe"   // portproxy runs in IpHlpSvc / svchost context
    | summarize EgressIPs = make_set(RemoteIP, 50) by DeviceId
  ) on DeviceId
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ProcessCommandLine, ListenPort, ConnectAddr, ConnectPort, EgressIPs
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend Img = tolower(NewProcessName), Cmd = tolower(CommandLine)
| where Img endswith "\\netsh.exe"
| where Cmd has "interface"
   and Cmd has "portproxy"
   and (Cmd has "add v4tov4" or Cmd has "add v4tov6" or Cmd has "add v6tov4" or Cmd has "add v6tov6")
| extend ListenPort = extract(@"listenport=([0-9]+)", 1, Cmd)
| extend ConnectAddr = extract(@"connectaddress=([^\s]+)", 1, Cmd)
| extend ConnectPort = extract(@"connectport=([0-9]+)", 1, Cmd)
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, ParentProcessName, CommandLine, ListenPort, ConnectAddr, ConnectPort
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Volt Typhoon - netsh portproxy Internal Relay
id: 8b3e7c92-1d4a-4f56-9c8d-7e2b6a3d1f47
status: experimental
description: Detects netsh.exe configuring a port-proxy v4to* rule - Volt Typhoon's signature internal-pivot technique used to relay C2 traffic through compromised hosts and out to KV-Botnet edge SOHO routers (CISA AA24-038A).
references:
    - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa24-038a
    - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1017/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/31
tags:
    - attack.command_and_control
    - attack.t1090.001
    - attack.t1090
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection_img:
        Image|endswith: '\netsh.exe'
    selection_cli_required:
        CommandLine|contains|all:
            - 'interface'
            - 'portproxy'
    selection_cli_action:
        CommandLine|contains:
            - 'add v4tov4'
            - 'add v4tov6'
            - 'add v6tov4'
            - 'add v6tov6'
    condition: selection_img and selection_cli_required and selection_cli_action
falsepositives:
    - Sanctioned admin port-forwarding for legacy services or developer relays - confirm with change ticket
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.security OR windows.sysmon) (@EventID:4688 OR @EventID:1) @Image:(*\netsh.exe OR *\NetSh.exe OR *\NETSH.EXE) @CommandLine:(*interface* OR *Interface* OR *INTERFACE*) @CommandLine:(*portproxy* OR *PortProxy* OR *PORTPROXY*) @CommandLine:(*"add v4tov4"* OR *"add v4tov6"* OR *"add v6tov4"* OR *"add v6tov6"* OR *"Add V4ToV4"* OR *"ADD V4TOV4"*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\netsh\.exe$/i
| regex("interface", field=CommandLine, strict=false)
| regex("portproxy", field=CommandLine, strict=false)
| CommandLine=/add\s+v[46]tov[46]/i
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| ListenPort := regex("(?i)listenport=(?<lp>[0-9]+)", field=CommandLine) | ConnectAddr := regex("(?i)connectaddress=(?<ca>[^\s]+)", field=CommandLine) | ConnectPort := regex("(?i)connectport=(?<cp>[0-9]+)", field=CommandLine)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, CommandLine], function=[count(), min(_time, as=FirstSeen), max(_time, as=LastSeen)])
| sort(LastSeen, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: Per CISA/NSA/FBI advisory AA24-038A and Microsoft's 'Volt Typhoon targets US critical infrastructure' report, the actor characteristically chains 'netsh interface portproxy add v4tov4 listenport=... connectaddress=... connectport=...' to bounce internal traffic through compromised hosts back to KV-Botnet edge nodes.
